aggregation: Original float32 sigmoid predictions and original float32 targets promoted to float64 before subtraction; sum float64 squared errors across all rows, divide by 50000. No unweighted averaging of batch means.
authority: Root binding S18 policy received before any S18 training/runtime permission or loss outcomes
checkpoint_selection: Final EPOCH2 only: epoch002-step{2*(indexed_training_rows//8192):09d}.pt; never select by any metric
integrity: No optimizer construction/step, backward, exports, project_weights or weight update in postscore
Hash checkpoint bytes, holdout bytes/modes and model state before/after; require equality
Preserve Torch RNG state around reconstruction/scoring; all arms original trainer seed25
model: Pinned original v3b one-head NNUE H256 residual QAT, strict state_dict from the preselected checkpoint
reader_targets_forward: Call pinned original v3b load_set/make_batch/targets/NNUE.forward; no replacement reader or target calculation
scope: Separate post-training scoring only; original trainer and optimizer/epoch batches/RNG recipe unchanged
